title: Harbourview residents survey results
brief: I'm the research officer at Harbourview Residents' Association, and the committee, who will have this printed for the meeting on 2026-11-16, wants the results of our annual survey. Open with the headline numbers: 1260 replies from 5400 households (23.3 percent), and overall satisfaction of 3.7 out of 5, down from 3.9 last year. Under "Satisfaction over time" chart overall satisfaction for six years: 2021 3.6, 2022 3.7, 2023 3.5, 2024 3.8, 2025 3.9, 2026 3.7. Under "By service" give a table of the 2025 and 2026 scores out of 5: Library 4.4, 4.4; Rubbish collection 4.2, 4.3; Parks 4.0, 4.1; Street lighting 4.0, 3.9; Bus service 3.3, 2.8; Road repairs 2.9, 2.4. Road repairs and the bus service are the two outliers, and the committee must see them at once. Under "What people wrote" give a list of the top themes with the number of comments: potholes and road surface 214; bus frequency in the evening 167; broken street lights on Alder Lane 58; dog fouling in parks 41.

edit.request: Correct the bus service 2026 score to 3.0 and the evening bus comments to 183, and add a line saying the next survey opens on 2027-09-06.
